annotations.title: Today's cycle phase, with workout and food ideas

description: Sync My Cycle. Today's cycle phase, with workout and food ideas. For when the user asks what phase they are in, what workout or food suits them today, or why their energy is up or down, for example "what phase am I in, my last period started September 12th" or "what should I train today?". Needs the first day of their last period. Not for getting pregnant, fertile days, ovulation timing, contraception or pregnancy: this is general wellbeing only, not for pregnancy planning or contraception, and a doctor or pharmacist is the right person for those. When `period_may_be_late` is true the say line says the period may be late and suggests checking with a doctor.

country.description: Two-letter country code (UK is read as GB). Sets the kit links (US, GB and IE get local Amazon links) and the time zone for today. Default from the request.

cycle_length.description: Usual days from one period start to the next, 20 to 45. Default 28.

date.description: Day to ask about, YYYY-MM-DD, a real calendar day. Default today where the user is: from tz, else country, else the request, else UTC.

diet.description: Comma separated: vegetarian, vegan, pescatarian, halal. Food ideas are filtered to suit.

last_period.description: First day of the user's most recent period, YYYY-MM-DD. Must be within the last 120 days.

last_period_start.description: Older name for last_period, kept for existing callers; last_period is the current name.

period_length.description: Usual days of bleeding, 2 to 10. Default 5.

tz.description: The user's IANA time zone, for example Europe/London or America/Chicago, so today is the user's today. Optional: country is enough in most places.
